evidence.reason: Line 177 expands both %i and %I with the raw instance extracted from the unit filename. systemd defines %i as the escaped instance and %I as its unescaped form; for an instance like `crq\x2dtick`, `Service=%I.service` must resolve to `crq-tick.service`, but this code produces `crq\x2dtick.service`, so the dependency scan can drop a real target. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended specifier expansion; apply systemd unit-name unescaping only to the %I replacement and leave %i raw.
